verses.text: Ixto yik' junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi' skuchan Cetura.
Ha heb' yuninal winh ix alji yet' ix, haton winhaj Zimram, winhaj Jocsán, winhaj Medán, winhaj Madián, winhaj Isbac yet' winhaj Súa.
Ha winhaj Jocsán smam winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán. Ha pax heb' yinhtilal winhaj Dedán jun, haton heb' asureo, heb' letuseo yet' heb' leumeo.
Haxo pax heb' yuninal winhaj Madián chi', haton winhaj Efa, winhaj Efer, winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Abida yet' winhaj Elda. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik yinhtilal winhaj Abraham chi' yet' ix Cetura.
Ix yak' winh masanil tas ay t'ay smakb'enok winhaj Isaac.

Haxo pax yune' juntzanhxo heb' ix chi' jun, haxonhej silab' ix ak'chaj t'a heb' yuj winh. Ayik pitzanto winh, ix och ijan winh schekankanel heb' winh chi' winh t'a stz'ey winhaj Isaac chi'. Ix chekjib'at heb' winh t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ha winhaj Abraham chi', 175 ab'il sk'inal winh ayik ix cham winh.
Ichamilxo ix ik'an scham winh.

Ha heb' yuninal winh, haton winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Ismael xit' mukan winh t'a k'e'en olan k'e'en t'a Macpela, t'a slak'anil lum slu'um winhaj Mamre t'a lum yikejnak junel winhaj Efrón yuninal winhaj Zohar, winh hitita.
Haton lum chi' manb'ilkan yuj winhaj Abraham t'a heb' hitita. Ha b'aj mukb'il ix Sara, hata' ix mukchaj winhaj Abraham chi'.
Haxo yik toxo ix cham winh, ix yak'ankot swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh winhaj Isaac. Ix kan kajan winh t'a slak'anil ha' uk'b'ila' skuchan Ha Dios Pitzan Tzin Hilani.
Haton yab'ixal heb' yinhtilal winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Abraham yet' ix Agar, ix aj Egipto, haton ix ek'nak criadail t'a ix Sara.
Haton stzolal tik, tas ix aj yalji heb': Winhaj Nebaiot, haton winh b'ab'el unin chi', slajwi chi' winhaj Cedar, winhaj Adbeel, winhaj Mibsam,
winhaj Misma, winhaj Duma, winhaj Masa,
winhaj Hadar, winhaj Tema, winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Cedma.
Haton sb'i heb' lajchawanh yuninal winhaj Ismael tik. Ha sb'i heb' winh chi' ix och sb'iok slu'um b'aj ix kajnaji. Junjun heb', yajal ix ajkan heb' t'a junjun chonhab'.
Ha winhaj Ismael chi', 137 ab'il sk'inal winh, ayik ix cham winh.

Ha masanil heb' yinhtilal winh chi', ix k'ochkan kajan heb' t'a skal Havila yet' Shur, t'a yichanhkot lum Egipto b'aj sb'at b'eal Asiria. Hata' ix kajnaj heb', wach'chom malaj snib'ej heb' sk'ab' yok heb'.
Haton yab'ixal winhaj Isaac yuninal winhaj Abraham:
40 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix yik'lan sb'a winh yet' ix Rebeca yisil winhaj Betuel, yanab' winhaj Labán arameo, haton winh kajan t'a Padán-aram.
Ha ix Rebeca chi' malaj yune' ix. Haxo winhaj Isaac ix lesalwi t'a Jehová yik tz'ak'ji yune' heb' yuj. Icha chi' jun, ix ab'ji slesal heb' yuj Jehová, ix och ix Rebeca yab'ixal.
Ha heb' unin chi', tiox heb'. Ix yak' owal heb' t'a yol sk'o'ol snun chi'. Yuj chi' ix sna' ix: ¿Tas yuj sja jun tik t'a wib'anh? xchi ix. Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at yalan sb'a ix t'a Jehová.

Ix tak'wi Jehová chi' t'a ix: Chab' chonhab'il ol aj yinhtilal heb' chawanh het'nak chi'. Yiktax manto aljok heb', ol och heb' ajk'olal t'ay junjun. Jun te ay yip, te tek'an t'a yichanh junxo. Ha winh b'ab'el, ol kan winh t'a yalanh smandar winh tzak'an, xchi t'a ix.
Ix k'och sk'ual yalji heb' yune' ix Rebeca chi', tiox heb' unin ix alji chi'.
Ha winh b'ab'el ix alji, te chak tzeminak yilji winh, te ay xil sniwanil winh, Esaú ix yak' heb' sb'iej winh.
Tzak'an ix alji junxo yuk'tak chi', yub'yub' och t'a sjaj yok winhaj Esaú chi', yuj chi' Jacob ix yak' heb' sb'iej. 60 ab'il sk'inal winhaj Isaac chi' ayik ix alji heb' yune' ix Rebeca chi'.

Ix k'ib'nhej chawanh unin chi'. Ha winhaj Esaú pechoj nok' ix sk'ulej winh. Anhej kaltak te' snib'ej winh tz'ek'i. Haxo pax winhaj Jacob chi', malaj b'aj tzek' winh t'a najat, aynhejek' winh t'a scampamento.
Te xajan winhaj Esaú yuj winhaj Isaac chi' yujto snib'ej winh schi nok' k'ultakil nok' sja yuj winh. Haxo pax winhaj Jacob jun, te xajan winh yuj ix Rebeca.
Ay jun k'ual, wan stz'anhan jun wa'el winhaj Jacob chi' ayik ix jax winhaj Esaú chi' b'eyelek' t'a kaltak te', te ay swejel winh.
Ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Jacob chi': Ak' wal jab'ok jun a wa'el chak yilji tik t'ayin, yujto tzin cham yuj wejel, xchi winh. (Yuj chi' Edom ix ak'ji sb'iej winh.)
--T'a sb'ab'elal, ak'kan a derecho yik b'ab'el winakil t'ayin, ichato chi' ol wak'ani, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Esaú chi': --Ina wan in cham yuj wejel, yilxo jun in derecho yik b'ab'el winakil chi', ¿tas wal ol och wu'uj? xchi winh.

--Ak'kan a ti' t'ayin t'a jun rato tik, xchi winhaj Jacob chi'. --Hinye, xchi winhaj Esaú chi'. Ix yak'an sti' winh yik sch'oxaneli to syak'kan sderecho winh yik sb'ab'el winakil t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'an ixim pan yet' jun plato wa'el winhaj Jacob chi' t'a winh. Haxo yik ix lajwi swa winh, ix k'e wa'an winh, ix b'at winh. Malaj yelk'och jun derecho yik b'ab'el uninal chi' t'a winh.
